description: In-game Wave Info panel readings from Tier 1 campaign runs, waves 1 to 8031, one reading per wave. Every value is what the panel displayed; nothing is derived.

provenance.source: Screenshots of the game's Wave Info panel, read by tooling/panel-capture/tower-panel-capture.swift (text recognition, each reading validated by format, chance total and repeated cells)
provenance.runs: Thirteen capture runs over one day and the following night. Where two runs recorded the same wave they showed the same chances and spawn rate; the later run's row is kept. Waves 2395 to 8031 come from one battle, captured in six parts; the player ended it there.

account.note: Same account as the Tier 7 fixture. Runs with and without cards equipped (Enemy Balance, Wave Accelerator) showed the same chances, spawn rate and speed.

perks.note: Trade-off perks that change panel rows, as listed on the game's Selected Perks screen for the battle that waves 2395 onward come from (screenshots supplied by the player on 2026-11-28). The screen lists the perks held, not when each was picked; the waves are where the panel first shows the effect. The readings up to wave 2368 come from earlier battles, which show the Boss perk's effect from wave 1500.

panelPerks.panelEffect: Boss health about 5.93 times Basic instead of 20 (0.2965; the screen's -70.3% is rounded); Boss speed 1.5 times

panelPerks.text: Ranged enemies attack distance reduced, but ranged enemies damage x3
Enemies have -50.5% health, but tower health regen and lifesteal -90%
x1.51 tower damage, but bosses have x8 health

notes: Health and attack are the panel's text: a mantissa cut (not rounded) to two decimals, and a suffix from 1,000 up.
attackSkips and healthSkips are the panel's Enemy Attack / Health Level Skip counters. The enemy level for a stat is the wave less that counter. They depend on the run, not on the wave.
eliteEach is the chance shown on each of the Vampire, Scatter and Ray rows.

bossHealth, bossSpeed, tankSpeed and protectorSpeed are recorded because the Boss row changes at wave 1500 in this run: its health goes from 20 times Basic to about 5.93 times, and its speed from 0.4 to 0.6 times Basic (the Tank's). That is the trade-off perk 'Boss health -70.3%, but boss speed +50%' (see perks), so it belongs to this run and not to wave 1500.

From wave 4458 every health in the panel is 0.495 of what it was a wave earlier, with attack and speed unchanged. That is the trade-off perk 'Enemies have -50.5% health' (see perks), so it belongs to this run and not to wave 4458.

The player reported that the game showed Overheat at wave 4500. On Tier 1 the Overheat conditions (Skip Decay, More Fleets) start at wave 15,000 per the wiki; clearing wave 4500 only makes the Overheat button appear. The readings from 4500 to 4667 show the ordinary step at wave 4500 and skip counters still rising.
From wave 4812 every attack in the panel is 0.495 of what it was a wave earlier. That is the trade-off perk 'Enemies damage -50.5%' (see perks).

At wave 5638 Boss health rises eightfold, from about 5.93 to about 47.4 times Basic, with Boss speed unchanged. That is the trade-off perk 'x1.51 tower damage, but bosses have x8 health' (see perks), so it belongs to this run and not to wave 5638.

From wave 4663 Saboteur health is written with a capital Q suffix, the one after q. Basic health reaches it at wave 5500 (1.52Q). The suffix after Q is a lowercase s: Boss health is written 1.12s from wave 6146, and with a capital S, the suffix after s, from wave 7797 (1.06S).
basicMass and saboteurMass are recorded from wave 2395, the run in which mass starts to change. Saboteur mass is written as a whole number with two zero decimals.

116 waves have no reading: a cell did not read, the panel was showing an earlier wave, a skip counter was misread, or (waves 2369 to 2394) the wave fell between two capture runs. The list is in missingWaves.

mass.note: Identical in every reading up to wave 4000. From there every row grows by the same factor; readings from wave 2395 carry basicMass and saboteurMass.
